name: ElfA
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game character, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A small cheerful wind-up toy elf helper, kid-friendly: round glossy body like a soft vinyl tin toy with a few small rivets and a dotted seam, a belt with a buckle, round bolt joints at the shoulders, short arms with mittens, striped legs, curly-toed shoes with little bells. Big round head with big shiny eyes, round cheeks, small nose, eager toothy grin, pointed elf ears. Floppy elf hat with a fur band and a bell on the tip. A big wind-up key on its back. Full body, standing, A-pose, arms slightly out, single character, no base, no props.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Glossy green painted tin body with gold rivets, brown belt with gold buckle, gold bolt joints, white mittens, red and white striped legs, green curly-toed shoes with gold bells. Shiny black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, peach skin. Red elf hat with white fur band and a gold bell. Brass wind-up key. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: Stand-in: hip 1.2, root 2 x 1.6 x 1 at the pivot, feet 2 studs below it, about 5 studs tall. Faces +Z in Meshy; yaw 180.

animations._note: Meshy library clips (3 credits each). Keys are what src/server/ElfBot.luau plays.
